author: @adrian.factomaton
scope: Offline response/polarity/eligibility specification and existing detached review adapter assessment only. No implemented router, new source review, non-author curation decision or API activation.
semantics: Only ordinary object/location recurrence across separate events is eligible; direction neutral, count free and no microscopic identity, odds, rate or independent-measurement claim.

Recognize the complete proposition and question polarity before selecting a response. Do not infer meaning from keyword overlap or strip negation. Finite examples do not define a general natural-language classifier.

Eligible positive possibility and literal universal never-twice rebuttal use full declarative responses. Bare Yes/No is prohibited for every negative or nested-polarity case. Do not copy the frozen positive answer into a negative-premise response.

The frozen factual verdict stays supported for the positive record. A future route can label the literal negative query as contradicted_by_record only as a reviewed query relationship; it is not a new factual review, frozen contradicted record or permission to bypass unsupported-verdict schemas.

Nested/uncertain polarity or missing referents require clarification. Unsupported conjuncts, historical event requests, personal safety questions and excluded precision/rate claims receive no C013 answer; no confident partial compound response is specified.
Every future eligible response must carry exact candidate/review bindings, scope, source dependence and inference disclosure. All current fixture answers remain null until every gate passes.
